summary: Verified the dragon-column-width fix in Overview tab (app/(tabs)/index.tsx) across phone (390x844), tablet (1200x800), and extra-wide (1920x1000) viewports via Playwright DOM bounding-box inspection + screenshots. MAX_COLUMN_WIDTH cap removal confirmed working: columnWidth is now always screenWidth-40 at all sizes (350px @390, 1160px @1200, 1880px @1920), matching the fix description. No large partial 2nd-dragon-column is visible anymore on wide/tablet viewports (the original bug is fixed). Scrolling the horizontal container (simulating swipe) correctly brings Logan's column flush to x=20 (same left padding Sif had) while Sif's column scrolls fully off-screen to negative x, at all tested widths. Regression checks passed: task-completion checkbox toggle (task-row-*-checkbox) correctly updates 'X af Y udført' progress count and persists (verified toggle-on then toggle-off cycle back to original '2 af 7 udført'), activity-state icons (active/brumation) present and clickable, page reload/re-fetch works without errors. Did NOT create or delete any dragons; Sif and logan real data untouched.

ui_bugs.issue: A consistent ~4px sliver of the next dragon's column is still technically within the viewport bounds at every screen width tested (390, 1200, 1920). Root cause: next column's x-position = leftPadding(20) + columnWidth(screenWidth-40) + gap(16) = screenWidth - 4, i.e. gap(16) > padding(20) is not the issue but the math always leaves exactly 4px of the 2nd column inside the viewport edge because gap only partially offsets the single side padding. It's imperceptible in screenshots/visual review (nowhere near the ~200px+ peek from the original 360px-cap bug) but technically doesn't fully satisfy 'zero pixels of 2nd dragon visible'. Consider bumping COLUMNS_GAP to >= 2*COLUMNS_HORIZONTAL_PADDING (i.e. 40) or reducing right-side allowance so next column starts exactly at screenWidth.

action_items: Optional polish: adjust COLUMNS_GAP/padding math so the next dragon column's left edge lands at exactly screenWidth instead of screenWidth-4, to fully eliminate the tiny 4px peek at all viewport sizes (low priority, not user-visible in practice).
critical_code_review_comments: app/(tabs)/index.tsx: columnWidth = screenWidth - COLUMNS_HORIZONTAL_PADDING*2 via useWindowDimensions is correctly reactive to viewport/orientation changes; snapToInterval={columnWidth+COLUMNS_GAP} correctly guarded with 'dragons.length > 1' check to avoid snap glitches with a single dragon.
DragonColumn.tsx receives width as a prop and applies it directly to the column View style - clean and correct, no internal width assumptions.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows passed (column width fix verified at 3 viewport sizes, swipe-flush behavior verified via scroll simulation, task toggle + activity icons regression-free)

seed_data_creation: None. No dragons created or deleted; verified real data (Sif id 6a4635bd66e797e6db9b8f13, logan id 6a59e9d05d53661a8cce782d) untouched throughout testing, and task completion toggle test was reverted back to original state (2 af 7 udført) after verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Main fix (removing MAX_COLUMN_WIDTH=360 cap) is confirmed working correctly at phone/tablet/extra-wide viewports - no more large partial 2nd-column peeking. Only a negligible cosmetic 4px sliver remains due to gap/padding math (see ui_bugs, LOW priority, likely not worth fixing unless user is very particular). Actual touch-swipe physics were simulated via direct scrollLeft manipulation (not a real drag gesture) per the review request's allowance for DOM-width verification as a proxy in web preview; real swipe feel should still be confirmed by user on an Android device.
rca_of_issue: N/A - fix verified working; only a minor 4px rounding artifact noted, not a functional bug.
